guard: the command lines Cotal writes for callers that outlive or bypass the public grammar keep the shape the binary accepts: the daemon argv up starts and the operator entries beside them, the owned unit's command line, the delegated seat command with and without its handoff, every bearer flag shape, completion stubs for each shell and the container entrypoint's commands
why: An installed completion stub that stops calling the stable completion entry breaks every shell that sourced it; the matrix must notice the generator changing.
The connector appends --manager-call to the seat's bearer argv on every manager call; a bearer entry that stops accepting it disconnects running seats, so the refresh shape must stay pinned.

mutations.name: installed completion stubs stop calling __complete
mutations.expectRed: completion install bash writes a stub that calls `cotal __complete`
mutations.cell: completion install bash writes a stub that calls `cotal __complete`

mutations.name: agent-bearer stops accepting the connector's refresh flag
mutations.find: { name: "manager-call", type: "boolean", description: "mint a token bound to one manager instance" },
mutations.replace: { name: "manager-bound", type: "boolean", description: "mint a token bound to one manager instance" },
mutations.expectRed: the connector's refresh shape `--manager-call` is accepted and reaches the token read
mutations.cell: the connector's refresh shape `--manager-call` is accepted and reaches the token read
